author: @lyraxana
title: Astra 与 Sol 双型号现身云端配额
summary: 截图显示 Google Cloud 配额页同时列出 base_model:gpt-6.2-astra 与 gpt-6.2-sol，是 Sol 型号首个可核对的公开线索。
title_en: Astra & Sol Surface in Google Cloud Quotas
summary_en: A Google Cloud quotas screenshot lists base_model:gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol side by side — the first checkable public trace of the Sol name.

author: @ZindanTech
title: Sol 会抢走 Astra 的风头吗
summary: 社区评论：若 Sol 与 Astra 同步发布，接近 Astra 的能力配上低得多的价格，可能让 Sol 成为日常主力——6.1 Sol 已以 1/5 价格提供接近 Astra 的智能。
summary_en: Commentary: if Sol ships next to Astra, near-Astra capability at a far lower price could make Sol the daily driver — GPT-6.1 Sol already offers near-Astra intelligence at 1/5 the API price.

author: @thsottiaux
title: Tibo 跟进暗示：ChatBLT
summary: OpenAI 的 Tibo 引用前帖只写下「ChatBLT」，未作任何解释，缩写的解读全部来自社区。
summary_en: OpenAI's Tibo quoted his own tease with a single word, 'ChatBLT', and never explained it; every reading of the acronym is the community's.

author: @thsottiaux
title: Tibo 暗示帖：Le GPT Fat
summary: OpenAI 的 Tibo 只发了三个词「Le GPT Fat」，没给型号也没给时间，社区普遍将其读作下一代 Astra / Sol 的预告。
summary_en: OpenAI's Tibo posted just three words — 'Le GPT Fat' — with no model name or date; the community widely read it as a next-gen Astra / Sol hint.

author: @karanC_12
title: 一个提示词，一个 3D RPG 世界
summary: KC 分享：单个提示词一键生成半开放世界 3D RPG（视频 57 秒，署名 Fini.Yang），作者标注为 GPT-6.2 Astra 灰度生成，并直接喊话 Opus 5.5。
summary_en: Shared by KC: a semi-open-world 3D RPG generated from a single prompt (57s video credited to Fini.Yang), labelled as GPT-6.2 Astra gray-rollout output — and pitched straight at Opus 5.5.
verification: 作者标注·未独立验证（Astra 线）
highlights: 演示视频署名为 Fini.Yang，KC 转述分享

author: @FiniYang
title: 鹈鹕 360° 立体骑车
summary: 作者标注的 GPT-6.2 Astra 灰度测试第一弹：经典「鹈鹕骑自行车」测试被做成可 360° 环视的 3D 场景（视频 18 秒）。
summary_en: The creator-labelled first GPT-6.2 Astra gray-rollout test: the classic pelican-on-a-bicycle test rendered as a 360°-viewable 3D scene (18s video).
verification: 作者标注·未独立验证（Astra 线）

author: @VeknQAQ
title: Codex 用量记录惊现 GPT-6.2 Astra
summary: 用户翻自己的模型用量时发现 gpt-6.2-astra 条目并截图发帖，是 6.2 灰度最早的目击之一。
title_en: GPT-6.2 Astra Spotted in Usage Records
summary_en: A user found a gpt-6.2-astra line in their own model-usage history and posted the screenshot — among the earliest 6.2 gray-rollout sightings.
